![banner](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MVS/BH_NU_HEADER.png) [![Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/D1D8LKA5N) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/869218732650688543?color=3e72b3&label=DISCORD&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.com/invite/S5nffJbuvA) [![CurseForge projects](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-projects-3e72b3?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge)](https://www.curseforge.com/members/finndog_123/projects) [![Modrinth projects](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-projects-3e72b3?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/user/FinnDog_123) [![查看結構](https://pub-24a4e0e7ea8544a5b6f73c3a23512589.r2.dev/images/c110cc09347a4f9f9de6c974f2fa35d8.png)](https://previews.moogsmods.com/voyager-structures/1.21.1/) ![總覽](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MVS/BH_NU_BANNER1.png) 此模組支援 Forge、Fabric、NeoForge 與 Quilt！亦可在伺服器端單獨安裝。1.20.4 版本後已停止支援 Forge。 ### 關於 Moogs Voyager Structures 透過充滿動態與趣味的新結構，徹底改變你的 Minecraft 體驗。這些結構使用原版方塊與生物精心打造，無縫融入遊戲，提供刺激的戰利品、具挑戰性的敵對生物與友善的村民。相容於任何模組包，在保留經典 Minecraft 風格的同時豐富你的世界。準備好與 Moogs Voyager Structures 一同踏上冒險與探索的旅程吧！ [![即時瀏覽每個結構的 3D 預覽](https://pub-24a4e0e7ea8544a5b6f73c3a23512589.r2.dev/images/f8fe835413394a76b10a678afefea30f.png)](https://previews.moogsmods.com/voyager-structures/1.21.1/) ### 設定包 模組的每個方面皆可透過資料包自訂。附有完整說明的範本可在[此處](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/mvs-moogs-voyager-structure-config-pack)找到。 ![功能](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MVS/BH_NU_BANNER2.png) ![拼貼](https://i.imgur.com/epC7vBE.png) ![展示](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MVS/BH_NU_BANNER4.png) ### 影片
### 模組包 所有模組包請參閱[此處](https://www.modpackindex.com/modpack/finder?included_mods=37802)。 ![banner](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MVS/BH_NU_BANNER3.png) 最快獲得回覆的方式是加入我們的 [Discord 伺服器](https://discord.gg/S5nffJbuvA)。 [![BHsponser](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/MVS/BH_NU_PROMO.png)](https://bisecthosting.com/moogsmods?r=cfmvs)
